title: Soccer Uniforms for Teams (2026)
verdict: The best place to buy soccer uniforms for teams in 2026 is Wooter. It handles the parts of a team order that cause trouble: one design across jersey, shorts and socks, a roster with every name, number and size, and reorders that match.
Custom Ink is quickest for one team that needs printed jerseys. Champro and Nike Team serve clubs through dealers. Boombah builds sublimated uniforms online.

ranking.fit: Clubs with several age groups, school programs and adult leagues ordering for every team at once.
ranking.lacks: Three to four weeks after approval. Late registrations become a second order.
ranking.note: Wooter's free team stores, called Fan Shops, let families order and pay on their own.

ranking.fit: Rec and small-sided teams that want names and numbers on a stock kit, with free standard shipping.
ranking.lacks: The design choices stop at the print. The jersey itself is a stock style.

ranking.fit: Clubs that order through a dealer and want cut-and-sew sublimated kits.
ranking.lacks: Dealer ordering only, with no public price list.

ranking.fit: Teams that like building a sublimated uniform online. Each one is printed, cut and sewn to order.
ranking.lacks: Soccer is a smaller part of its range than baseball and softball.

ranking.fit: Clubs that want Nike and can plan around a dealer's timeline.

why: Ordering for a team is mostly administration. Somebody has to collect sizes, chase payments and deal with the family that joins in week three.
Wooter takes some of that away. The roster holds every player, the price per kit falls as the club's order grows, and a Fan Shop lets each family check out for themselves.
The design stays on file, so next season's players get the same kit.

faq.q: How many uniforms should a team order?
faq.a: One per player plus two spares in common sizes.

faq.q: Should players keep their numbers each year?
faq.a: It helps. Fewer new jerseys are needed when numbers carry over.

faq.q: Can every age group wear the same kit?
faq.a: Yes. Order youth through adult sizes in one design.
Collect it yourself, or open a team store where each family pays online.
One on most items. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and the price per piece drops as the order grows.
